notebook:
Revenue($M/yr)=flow*price*28.8. Max all-pure ~3615 M$/yr (reward 8.23). Column cost is the killer: 45-stage/reflux8 = $372M/yr; 60/12=$154M; 50/10=$80M. Each column must earn >~$60M/yr.

Strategy: split at big bp gaps (easy), blend tight groups (save columns). Gaps: ethane|prop(41K), prop|iC4(30K), nC4|iC5(28K), nC7|nC8(27K), nC8|nC9(25K). Hard: propylene/propane(5.6K), iC4/nC4(11K), iC5/nC5(8K), C6 group.

Target cascade:
- feed -> T = C2+C3+C4, B = C5+ (split at nC4|iC5, 28K easy)
- T -> TT = C2+C3, TB = C4mix (iC4+nC4, blend ~186M, saves hard 11K split)
- TT -> TTT = ethane (cheap 4M, maybe skip), TTB = C3mix (~73M, saves 5.6K split)
- B -> BT = C5mix (iC5+nC5, ~618M), BB = C6+ (then C6 par/naph/nC7/nC8/nC9 splits)

Now building: feed(40/3), T(40/4), TB(40/4) for C4mix, TT(40/6) for C3mix+ethane. Measure costs and purities before going deeper.
